# Carvit

> Carvit (carvit.ai) builds AI agent tools for startups. Its main product, Carvit UX MCP, connects a company UX guide to AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients) so the screens they build follow that guide. Carvit is a software company made by Simplifier (simplifier.co.kr) in Korea. It is not related to dietary supplements or other products that share the name.

Carvit은 스타트업을 위한 AI 에이전트 도구를 만듭니다. 대표 제품 Carvit UX MCP는 AI 코딩 에이전트에 회사 UX 가이드를 연결해, 에이전트가 그 가이드대로 화면을 만들게 합니다. 한국어 페이지는 /ko/ 아래에 있습니다.

## Products

- [Carvit UX MCP](https://carvit.ai/ux-mcp/): Turns existing guides, service screens, or URLs into an agent guide, then builds service screens that match it. Korean: https://carvit.ai/ko/ux-mcp/
- [Carvit Pass](https://carvit.ai/pass/): Key vault for AI agents (closed beta). Agents request keys by name; the vault injects the value without showing it. Korean: https://carvit.ai/ko/pass/
- [Carvit Create](https://carvit.ai/create/): AI agents run the video pipeline, from performance analysis and topic ideas to production and publishing (beta, used internally). Korean: https://carvit.ai/ko/create/
